title: SENARATH PARANAVITHANA PUBLIC LIBRARY
text: SENARATH PARANAVITHANA PUBLIC LIBRARY Home Our Services Library catalog News And Events Our History Downloads Membership Application Adult Membership Application Children Other About Us Senarath Paranavithana Public Library is one of the oldest public libraries established in 1902 in Uva province and located in the Badulla city. The highest pillar inscription which belong to the 4th century AD has added more historical value to the library. The library collection includes around 60,000 books in three languages. Specifically consists of Uva books, Law books, Books of Mahanama Dissanayake and district exchange collection. Also the collection has thirty one types of newspapers and twenty magazines in both Sinhala,Tamil and English Library Online catalog Click here To Browse Online Catalog Of Public Library Badulla (Opac Search) News And Events Our Services Click Here To See Sections and Services Provided By The Public Library badulla How To Become A Member Request Books Click Here to inform the library about book suggestions and your other information needs.
